explication: Tianshou is a PyTorch reinforcement-learning library with procedural and high-level APIs. The principal workflow configures an algorithm and environment, collects interaction data, stores experience, trains the algorithm, and reports results. Its algorithm scope includes model-free, imitation, model-based, and multi-agent RL; it also supports vectorized environments, prioritized and hindsight replay, and experiment evaluation. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with sampled trainer, collector, environment, and experiment code; links for unsampled subsystem internals are limited to documented workflow relationships.
